title: I.N.D.I.A. bloc to stage protest at Bengaluru's Freedom Park on Nov 5 against SIR, CEC resignation
summary: Hariprasad accused the BJP and RSS of attempting to undermine democracy by misusing constitutional institutions and said the agitation would continue until Kumar resigned.

title: Karnataka Deputy CM Parameshwara writes to PM Modi, seeks Rs 22,400 cr drought relief
summary: Karnataka has declared 226 taluks as drought-affected with crops spread across 57.93 lakh hectares suffering damage.

title: Karnataka signs agreement with Rotary Bengaluru; launches laptop, computer distribution under Jnana Setu scheme
summary: As explained by the minister, the Jnana Setu will help the government to address the need for computers at the colleges with a large number of students.

title: VAO exam: KEA releases list of 5,000 candidates, marks scored to prove transparency
summary: The probe by the DC into the performance of the Haveri candidate in the VAO examination found that he had extensively used his mobile phone while writing the exam.
